_why: Example value, apps.json (the app registry) at schemaVersion 2 — one entry with every field the version defines, at the values the writer emits for a fresh app. Also the sample both halves of the file-format contract are held to: the app's vitest parses it through the real registry reader and re-renders it (app/src/host/contract/site-files.test.ts), and nix flake check maps every entry through platform/lib/registry-lib.nix (the example-host check).

presentation.description: A documentation app: every field of the v2 entry, once.
